usage: 喜歡 (hei2 fun1) is commonly used as a verb meaning 'to like' or 'to be fond of'.
It can describe liking people, things, activities, or food.
喜歡 (hei2 fun1) is often followed by a noun or verb phrase, e.g., '我喜歡食飯' (I like eating rice).
You can use 喜歡 (hei2 fun1) in questions to ask about preferences, e.g., '你喜歡呢個嗎？' (Do you like this?).
It can be used in both casual and formal conversations.
